mcpEndpoint.description: Remote MCP endpoint URL when the gateway can proxy this server.

credentialKey.description: Gateway credential suffix used for private proxyable MCPs, forming x-chainlove-cred-{credentialKey}.

x402.label: x402
x402.description: Whether the MCP server supports x402 payments.

onChainWrite.label: On-Chain Write
onChainWrite.description: Whether MCP tools can execute state-changing on-chain actions.

agentSkills.label: Agent Skills
agentSkills.description: Capabilities exposed to AI agents (MVP free-form strings).

creator.label: Creator
creator.description: Tx sender that created the agent (initial Registered() call).

creatorTx.label: Creator Tx
creatorTx.description: Transaction hash of the initial Registered() call.

agentURIType.label: URI Type
agentURIType.description: Type of the Agent URI (ipfs, https, etc.).

agentWallet.label: Agent Wallet
agentWallet.description: Wallet address associated with the agent.

name.label: Name
name.description: Agent name from ERC-8004 registration file (agentURI).

image.label: Image
image.description: Image URL from ERC-8004 registration file.

active.label: Active
active.description: Whether the agent is marked active in the registration file (ERC-8004).

supportedTrust.label: Supported Trust
supportedTrust.description: Trust models supported by the agent (e.g. reputation, crypto-economic, tee-attestation) from ERC-8004.

totalFeedbackCount.label: Total Feedback
totalFeedbackCount.description: Total number of feedback entries (including revoked).

averageRating.label: Avg Rating
averageRating.description: Average reputation rating from active feedback.

registeredAt.label: Registered At
registeredAt.description: Unix timestamp when the agent was registered on-chain.

updatedAt.label: Updated At
updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp of the last on-chain update.

rank.label: Rank
rank.description: Bayesian-weighted rank among all agents on this chain (1 = best).
